title: Pencil sketch of object "glimmering pure white" with "indistinct ring" and binocular view
description: Hand-drawn pencil sketch of a cross- or star-shaped object with four arms and a pointed top, surrounded by a jagged circular halo; labels read "GLIMMERING PURE WHITE" and "INDISTINCT RING." Below a dividing line, a second sketch labeled "AS APPEARING IN GLASS" shows a circle marked "15 MIN FIELD" with a small dot representing the object. A typed note reads: "This B&L glass will pick out the rungs on the ladders of the 200E area from the top of Badger Mountain. I guess a distance of 15 or 20 miles."
